form:FormGroup.label: Permission Visibility
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Filters the documents list: explicit, effective or all.

form:HelpHTML.p: This dropdown controls which documents/folders are shown in the list.

ul.li: Show Explicit - Show only those documents/folders that this user/group has an explicit permission on.
Show Effective - Show only those documents/folders that this user/group has an explicit or inherited permission on. The permission may be inherited from an ancestor group.
Show All - Shows all documents/folders regardless of permissions held. Select this to grant new permissions to this user/group.
